text: Relative housing values have dropped more than 10 percent from ____ peak in the first half of the year.
explanation: We need a possessive adjective before the noun "peak" => B is correct

text: The botanical garden____ on the south side of the island and can easily be found on any map.
explanation: Be located on => A is correct

text: A special luncheon for the advertising team will be____ in the main banquet hall of the Phalya Hotel.
explanation: "Held" is the past participle of "hold". "Hold" means "to have something such as a meeting or an election" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: Because it is taking____ long for the staff to get used to the software, the office manager is planning to organize a training workshop.
explanation: "Unexpectedly" means "in a way that is not expected" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: ____ newly-hired employees on the management level should attend the training workshop about the company values.
explanation: All + plural noun (employees)

text: Masara Bankole, an award-winning____ at the Toronto Star, has agreed to host radio show for charity fundraising.
explanation: The blank needs a noun. "Journalist" means "a person who writes news stories or articles for a newspaper or magazine or broadcasts them on radio or television" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: Although a sufficient number of rooms in the company housing were offered, several attendees chose to stay at a ____hotel instead.
explanation: An adjective is needed to modify the noun "hotel". "Nearby" means "not far away" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: Halloween costumes of the faculty members are welcome but entirely____.
explanation: "Optional" means "not necessary or demanded but possible or available; depending on what you decide to do" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: Saitama Vehicles Company is expected to reach this year’s sales goal by ____ record sales numbers in the third quarter of the year.
explanation: "Achieve" means "to succeed in finishing something or reaching an aim, especially after a lot of work or effort" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: Image Horizon Corporation announced this morning that its chief financial officer, Julia Park, will____ Maholia Green as chief executive officer on March 22.
explanation: "Replace" means "to take the place of something, or to put something or someone in the place of something or someone else" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: Montaz Motorcycles wants to make the partnership between the product and research department ____.
explanation: Make something + adj => C is correct

text: The display in the Raymond Art Gallery will feature a number of____ creative art works by promising contemporary artists.
explanation: An adverb is needed to modify the adjective "creative" => D is correct

text: Whether the tour members take a sightseeing cruise on the waterway ____ spend the day visiting the museum, they will be relaxed and comfortable.
explanation: Whether … or => D is correct

text: The new innovative diesel engine works____ than the other competitive engines of other companies.
explanation: An adverb is needed to modify the verb "work". Because there is "than", we need to use "more" => D is correct

text: The proposed service center would provide additional services _______ Kovac Industry customers in the region.
explanation: Provide something to somebody => B is correct

text: The Gift Boy company has a system to automatically send____ of every online order by e-mail.
explanation: The blank needs a noun => D is correct

text: Reed-Winton Machines____ announced that its researchers are in the final stages of developing a revolutionary new natural gas-powered engine.
explanation: "Recently" means "not long ago, or at a time that started not long ago" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: Guests who are interested in tomorrow’s ____ to Ko Kret Island may join the tour group by signing up at the reception desk.
explanation: "Excursion" means "a short journey usually made for pleasure, often by a group of people" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: Of all the customers____ responded to the survey, 80 percent usually purchase industrial products online.
explanation: A relative pronoun is needed to fill in the blank. "Who" is the most correct since it refers to people (customers)

text: The Library of the National Assembly is ____ to all members of the public, but books cannot be checked out.
explanation: "Open" means "ready to be used or ready to provide a service" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: The recruiter in charge of the vacancy will examine the applications and contact the candidates____ the next five working days.
explanation: "Within" means "inside or not further than an area or period of time" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: Due to____ weather conditions, all ships scheduled to depart from Port Bremerhaven have been delayed.
explanation: "Unfavorable" means "not positive" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: In the last decade, there has been____ little medical research achievement regarding the factors that can affect human memory.
explanation: An adverb is needed to modify the adjective "little" => A is correct

text: The proper____ of steps must be followed to ensure that the television is mounted on the wall securely.
explanation: "Sequence" means "a series of related things or events, or the order in which they follow each other" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: Mr. Fernandez called to ask if his Monday morning meeting could be postponed____ later in the week.
explanation: "Until" means "not before a particular time or event" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: The Delain Technology is aggressively seeking seasoned computer programmers with____ skills that enable them to solve the clients’ most demanding security needs.
explanation: An adjective is needed to modify the noun "skills" => B is correct

text: Watertrek Power company has recently had to____ the rate it charges for electricity due to rising expenses.
explanation: "Increase" means "to (make something) become larger in amount or size" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: Venetian Blinds Company’s colorful blinds and curtains are guaranteed to____ your home atmosphere.
explanation: "Enhance" means "to improve the quality, amount, or strength of something" which has the most appropriate meaning

text: The Kilimanjaro Espresso Chain distributes mugs instead of____ promotional items because of their durability and visibility.
explanation: Other + plural noun => A is correct

text: At a retirement dinner last week, Kenichi Tatsumi ____ for his 30 years of service to the Range Engineering Group.
explanation: We need to use the passive voice. The structure of passive voice is "be + past participle" => D is correct
